installAppSubtitle: Access Wallet.ia from your home screen like a native app.
installIosStep1: Open Wallet.ia in Safari and tap the Share button on the bottom bar (square icon with an arrow pointing up).
installIosStep2: In the share menu, scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
installIosStep3: Tap "Add" in the top-right corner. The Wallet.ia icon will appear on your home screen.
installAndroidStep1: Open Wallet.ia in Google Chrome and tap the three-dots menu (⋮) in the top-right corner.
installAndroidStep2: Select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
installAndroidStep3: Confirm the installation by tapping "Install". The app will be added to your home screen.
installIosNotice: On iOS devices (Apple), installation must be done through Safari's Share menu following the steps above.
